purpose: Find a stronger ScienceClaw entry; lead owns selection, implementation and final artifacts. This receipt is launch evidence, not evidence that a winning idea has been found.

sessions.name: delphi-rethink-nca
sessions.goal: /goal Produce and push a primary-source-grounded NCA/amorphous inverse-design proposal plus a reproducible decisive feasibility experiment with strong baselines, independent validation and operational Delphi claim reuse; deliver a concise go/no-go recommendation and hand it to delphi-rethink-director. Read planning/rethink/GOAL.md and planning/rethink/roles/nca.md. A survey or self-validating animation does not satisfy this goal.

sessions.name: delphi-rethink-electric
sessions.goal: /goal Find and experimentally probe the strongest feasible bioelectric-control, electrically guided fabrication or cellular-computing entry using available primary data or independently validated models; push a concrete prototype, comparator, actual Delphi-claim reuse and an honest go/no-go memo for delphi-rethink-director. Read planning/rethink/GOAL.md and planning/rethink/roles/electric.md. Do not claim fabricated material or biological validation from a simulator alone.

sessions.name: delphi-rethink-critic
sessions.goal: /goal Independently identify the strongest ScienceClaw idea and three-minute pitch achievable today, challenge Darwin's Bridge and the NCA/bioelectric alternatives against primary prior art, real validation and the live judging rubric, and push a ranked decision memo with a concrete wildcard feasibility check and an investible pilot hypothesis. Read planning/rethink/GOAL.md and planning/rethink/roles/critic.md. Do not rubber-stamp the existing project or promise a win.

sessions.name: delphi-rethink-director
sessions.goal: /goal Lead the four standalone Claude tmux sessions to select and deliver a stronger evidence-backed ScienceClaw entry before the recorded deadline: compare all independent proposals, choose using executed feasibility evidence, integrate a working useful prototype with strong evaluation and actual Delphi claim reuse, and publish an honest three-minute pitch, demo, blog and downloadable artifacts. Read planning/rethink/GOAL.md and planning/rethink/roles/director.md. Preserve the released baseline. Do not stop at another plan or claim a hackathon win without a result.
